n: Pinnguaq Unplugged coding vocabulary match game
t: A printable memory match game that teaches basic coding vocabulary.
steps: Find the Coding Vocabulary Match Game PDF from Pinnguaq.
Print the activity cards and the reference sheet.
Cut out the cards and shuffle them.
Write the words and definitions by hand if you have no printer.
Read the reference sheet with students before the first game.
Let students play alone or in pairs.
